work.name: ISCL Lab, Nanjing University
work.summary: High-Speed Interconnect Transceiver with Dielectric Waveguide
highlights: Designed a D-band sub-harmonic mixer module in TSMC 28nm CMOS process, executing the full IC design flow including schematic design, physical layout, and tape-out verification using Cadence Virtuoso.

Conducted 3D electromagnetic (EM) modeling and co-simulation in Ansys HFSS for millimeter-wave passive components (inductors and transmission lines) to accurately extract and mitigate high-frequency layout parasitics.
Optimized the broadband impedance matching networks and enhanced port isolation by refining the symmetric layout of the mixing core.

projects.name: Multi-Modal Flexible Tactile Sensor for Robotic Material Recognition
projects.summary: National-Level College Student Innovation Training Program (Project Lead).
highlights: Spearheaded overall project architecture and technical roadmap for a robotic multi-modal tactile sensing system.
Designed and validated mixed-signal peripheral readout circuits for high-precision material conductivity measurement.
Performed FEA in Abaqus and structural modeling in AutoCAD to optimize the modulus-sensing unit.

projects.name: Reconfigurable Computing Platform for UAV Edge-Side Intelligent Vision
projects.summary: Provincial-Level College Student Innovation Training Program (Co-Lead).
highlights: Constructed experimental flight testbeds and executed field data acquisition to build and filter UAV vision datasets.
Optimized YOLO object-detection architectures and deployed quantized models onto reconfigurable edge-computing hardware.
